title: Orayan minimal event capture design V1

decision_episode.trigger: First observation of a distinct episode/config/strategy-bar/admission-or-primary-blocker/regime/structural boundary. Repeated returns to that boundary within the same strategy bar are suppressed. Exact latest snapshots remain frozen at native and V3 admission attempts and active replacement eligibility.

trade_lifecycle.trigger: Admitted, intent, ack, fill, cancel/expire, funding-finalization or terminal transition

experiment_arm.trigger: Only current registered active arm admission, geometry reject, status/fill/management/terminal change; exclude DORMANT

management_path.trigger: Actual stop/target/BE/trailing transition or terminal aggregate; no raw bars/MARK snapshots

errors_health.trigger: First compact sanitized occurrence, changed counters at bucket end, rare severe occurrence

configuration.trigger: First use of an allowlisted nonsecret decision config hash in an epoch

capture_status.trigger: Changed event/counter/retention state; durable all-time ledger independent of retained segment subset

notes: Field name ending _IF_GATE_ACTIVE is conditional, not an actual output field.
Direct nested allowed values are small dictionaries under these paths, not arbitrary source-object spreads.
Trade funding remains for actual net outcome calculation.
Working execution state and breaker aggregates are protected, excluded from new research population.

The original frozen proposal remains unchanged in orayan_capture_schema_vNext.json and Git docs. This implemented companion resolves conditional names, actual native aliases and safeguards based on live verification. Fields are conditional on existing executor availability; absent fields are not fabricated.
Native execution currently has no MAE/MFE aggregates, explicitly UNAVAILABLE_IN_EXISTING_EXECUTOR. Existing V3 simulator final aggregates are preserved.
Hypothetical BE/structural milestones are not executable stop changes. Dormant trailing remains dormant.
Space cap rotates complete old segments and durably records pruned rows; population counters exclude inherited trades. Actual stop/BE rule logic is unchanged.

Bounded native candidate continuity index (maximum 4096 identity/timestamp/signature entries) is operational metadata, persisted at event/status flush and graceful shutdown. Restore retains the existing 30-minute episode-gap rule. No raw candidate payload is stored in that index.

Primary blocker selection is a capture-only convention: first sorted failed-gate code. This never changes gate ordering, entry eligibility or rejected reasons in the trading engine. Exact admission-time snapshots remain complete.

V3 eligibility rejections are retained for meaningful native candidates even when V3 has no permitted side. Empty scans remain absent. Each distinct native/V3 configHash has its allowlisted nonsecret configuration definition.

Worker queue: maximum 1024 messages and 8 MiB projected record bytes; 128 message slots reserved for priority endpoints. Native continuity updates are coalesced by identity, maximum 4096, without telemetry rows. Whole worker state is copied only on startup, explicit flush/export or close.

Initial runtime overflow losses and legacy comparison-counter restarts make the early new-epoch sample exploratory; export completeness remains false. Future working comparison counters survive restarts within the same minimal epoch.

Export manifests carry the capture-policy source hash, revision start time, first event sequence and loss baseline so analysts can separate the corrected observation window from earlier exploratory records.
